Fifth-grade textbook includes Aishwarya Rai song lyrics

A textbook for fifth-grade students in Odisha has reportedly included the lyrics to the song 'Nimbooda Nimbooda' from the movie 'Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam', which features actress Aishwarya Rai. This inclusion has sparked debate and controversy regarding the content being taught to young children.
